% Adapted from TeX Live 2025 TKZdoc-euclide-clipping.tex, lines 138--150.
% Keeps the native bisector construction while omitting the clipping demo shell.
\documentclass[border=3pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{tkz-euclide}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \tkzDefPoint(0,0){O}
  \tkzDefPoint(3,1){I}
  \tkzDefPoint(1,4){J}
  \tkzDefLine[bisector](I,O,J)\tkzGetPoint{i}
  \tkzDefLine[bisector out](I,O,J)\tkzGetPoint{j}

  \tkzDrawLines[add=1 and 2,color=orange](O,I O,J)
  \tkzDrawLines[add=1 and 2,dashed](O,i O,j)
  \tkzDrawPoints(O,I,J,i,j)
  \tkzLabelPoints[below left](O)
  \tkzLabelPoints[below right](I)
  \tkzLabelPoints[above](J)
  \tkzLabelPoint[left](i){$i$}
  \tkzLabelPoint[right](j){$j$}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
